tandemFrageBeispiel.frage: What were you doing at eight o'clock?

tandemSoGehts: Cut the cards in the middle. Partner A takes the left half, Partner B takes the right half.
A builds question 1 from the tiles and asks it: “Why were you late for work?”
B hears the question and builds the answer. The blue verb changes: -ing after was / were (an action in progress), or the past participle after had (something that happened earlier).
Then B asks question 2 and A answers. Take turns. At the end, check with the answer sheet.
Last, swap cards and do it all again, faster.

tandemRedemittel.p2: Had + past participle: it happened before the main event.

tandemRedemittel.p1: Sorry? Can you say that again, please?

tandemFragen.frage: Why were you late for work?
tandemFragen.antwort: The bus had left before I arrived.

tandemFragen.frage: What was Liam doing at nine?
